Clinical, Morphological, and Molecular Evaluations of Bone Regeneration With an Additive Manufactured Osteosynthesis Plate.

Andreas Thor, Anders Palmquist, Jan-Michaél Hirsch, Lars-Erik Rännar, Per Dérand et al. The Journal of craniofacial surgery 2016-10-01 10.1097/SCS.0000000000002939
单位: *Department of Surgical Sciences, Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery, Uppsala University, Uppsala †Department of Biomaterials, Institute of Clinical Sciences, Sahlgrenska Academy at University of Gothenbu
相关性: 该论文涉及增材制造骨板与骨整合，但缺乏LPBF力学测试和疲劳分析，与用户研究方向的相关性有限。
边界: This paper does not include LPBF fabrication or mechanical testing (static or fatigue), nor does it link porous structure to stress shielding or stiffness matching.
动机· 评估电子束熔化定制骨板的骨再生效果
方法· 结合显微CT、组织学、PCR等分析取出后的定制骨板与再生骨

验证· 临床病例分析，包括影像、组织学和分子验证
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To assess the biological status of bone regenerated with a patient-specific additive manufactured osteosynthesis plate in mandibular reconstruction.
Method· Micro-CT, backscattered SEM, histology, and qPCR were used to evaluate bone regeneration and osseointegration of the retrieved plate after 33 months.
Result· The posterior two-thirds of the plate showed new bone formation, ingrowth, and osseointegration, supported by elevated expression of bone-related genes.
Validation· Clinical retrieval study with combined morphological and molecular analyses.

Motivation· To develop a rapid screening method for studying the influence of surface roughness on cell response using gradient surfaces on zirconia.
Method· A roughness gradient was fabricated on zirconia via hydrofluoric acid etching and characterized by white light interferometry and atomic force microscopy for multiscale topographical parameters.

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To develop a nonviral gene delivery approach for reconstituting critical-size bone defects.
Method· A BMP-2-encoding plasmid was embedded in PDLLA coatings on titanium discs and implanted into rat mandibular defects.
Result· Low DNA doses promoted complete bone healing within 112 days in a dose-dependent inverse manner.
Validation· Validation was performed in a rat model using micro-CT, histology, and fluorescence analysis.

动机· 比较多孔钛支架与PEEK及同种异体骨的骨整合强度。
方法· 在猪颅骨植入支架，5周后推出测试评估界面强度。

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· This biomechanical study aims to compare the strength of the implant-bone interface of a porous titanium scaffold against PEEK and allograft in a porcine model.
Method· Titanium, PEEK, and allograft pins were press-fit into drilled holes in swine skulls, and after 5 weeks of healing, push-out testing was performed to measure maximum force and shear strength.
Result· Porous titanium scaffolds exhibited significantly higher mean push-out shear strength (10.2 MPa) compared to PEEK (1.5 MPa) and allograft (3.1 MPa).
Validation· Validation involved in vivo implantation in a porcine model followed by ex vivo mechanical push-out testing.

Motivation· To investigate the influence of titanium surface topography on osteogenic differentiation of dental pulp stem cells.

Motivation· To investigate the surface characterization and biocompatibility of ultrafine-grain pure titanium processed by equal channel angular pressing for dental implant applications.
Method· Ultrafine-grain Ti was produced via ECAP, followed by sandblasting and acid-etching surface treatment, and evaluated in vitro with MC3T3-E1 cells and in vivo in rabbit femurs.
Result· UFG-Ti exhibited improved mechanical strength and superior osseointegration compared to commercially pure titanium, as confirmed by pull-out tests.
Validation· In vitro cell assays and in vivo animal study with micro-CT, histology, and mechanical pull-out testing.

Motivation· To understand how laser surface treatment parameters affect cell distribution on titanium substrates for bone implant applications.

Motivation· To investigate the recrystallization behavior and thermal stability of an austenitic alloy fabricated by selective laser melting.
Method· Microstructural evolution at various annealing temperatures was characterized using metallography, scanning electron microscopy, and transmission electron microscopy.

边界: This paper focuses on motion prediction in dynamic environments using occupancy grids, with no FEA surrogate modeling, no uncertainty quantification for physical simulations, and no biomechanics or implant design context.
动机· 动态环境中运动预测对安全规划至关重要，但准确识别和跟踪多个物体极具挑战。
方法· 提出循环流网络，从占用网格序列推断每个单元的速度和未来占用概率，并用贝叶斯优化调参。
结果· 在预测精度和噪声鲁棒性上优于多种光流方法和贝叶斯占用网格滤波器。

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· Accurate motion prediction in dynamic environments is critical for safe planning, but robustly tracking multiple objects under occlusions and illumination changes remains difficult.
Method· A recurrent flow network is proposed to infer per-cell velocity and future occupancy probability from occupancy grid sequences, with parameters optimized via Bayesian optimization.
Result· The proposed method outperforms Lucas-Kanade, Lucas-Kanade with Tikhonov regularization, Horn-Schunck, and a Bayesian occupancy grid filter in prediction accuracy and noise robustness.
Validation· Validation is performed on benchmark datasets comparing against three optical flow methods and a Bayesian occupancy grid filter.

Motivation· To compare the tear-out resistance and failure behavior of osseo-integrated versus non-integrated screw sockets and cemented polyethylene cups in acetabular component removal.
Method· Axial tear-out testing was performed on ten human cadaveric coxal bones with three groups: osseo-integrated screw sockets, post-mortem implanted screw sockets, and cemented polyethylene cups.

Motivation· To evaluate whether short-stem prostheses achieve superior clinical and radiological outcomes compared to conventional implants in primary total hip arthroplasty.

Motivation· To achieve effective radar imaging of micromotion targets when radar returns are incomplete and phase-corrupted due to interference and motion compensation errors.

Motivation· To compare patient compliance and preference for oral versus subcutaneous anticoagulants after total hip arthroplasty.

Validation· Level I randomized clinical trial with patient-reported outcomes.
